name: Hoagie Boyz
statusNote: Shipped concept/pitch site, live. Dressed to the client's own meme-brutalist brand rather than the house style; real transactions defer to the shop's actual ordering site.
oneLiner: A one-page concept site for a brutalist, meme-branded Italian sub shop in South Osborne, built speculatively as a pitch.
stack: Google Fonts CDN, Open Graph meta

components.name: index.html
components.desc: Sticky nav with hamburger, hero, scrolling marquee banner, Featured grid, two-column menu, dark-band Story section, Visit section, footer

components.name: Hero SVG
components.desc: Inline hand-drawn SVG of a donkey dragging a giant submarine sandwich — a nod to the shop's original sign

components.name: Hours highlighter
components.desc: JS highlights today's line in the hours list

components.name: pitch.html
components.desc: The proposal, styled in a brutalist tomato/mustard/ink palette with print-friendly rules

dataFlow: Single-page scrolling site; nav anchors navigate within the document.
CTAs: tel: click-to-call, an external Apple Maps link, and an outbound link to the shop's real live ordering site — the concept defers real transactions there.
No embedded map iframe and no contact form; the map is an external deep link.
integrations: Google Fonts (Anton, DM Sans, Permanent Marker)
Outbound link to the shop's real ordering domain
decisions: Deliberately deadpan meme voice matching the shop's real brand personality — client work wears the client's brand, not the house style.
Brutalist look: thick borders, hard shadows, sticker chips.
No stock photography — the only imagery is the hand-drawn inline SVG.
Menu disclaims that prices are recent and may shift.
